body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A modest old service shaft, a dark oval opening with a hand winch, bed niches and patched timber around its rim. People gather beyond the void; the mage is on its near dark edge. No monumental architecture. COMPOSITION: Overhead view with half the well hidden by a broad roof; a small winding stair links unequal ledges. COLOR SCRIPT: moss olive, iron gray, worn leather brown, a few pale warm lamps. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
